title: ONE Trick for Easier Resume Updating
description:
Can’t remember what you did in your last job? Here’s how to document your work achievements as you go so it’s less work when you’re ready to update your resume. Think about your resume a little every month so when it’s time to update it, it’s not the first time you’ve looked at it in the last year. #resume #resumetips #jobsearch #jobsearching
